messages:
taylor: quick design question — the compact dashboard's Y axis is getting really cramped when we switch to 'compact' row density. abbrev units like 'k' and 'M' look wrong for fractional values (e.g. 0.5k). thoughts on alternatives?
anuj: +1 noticed this too. two quick options: 1) use SI prefixes but round (500 -> 0.5k) and show full value on hover, or 2) switch to locale-aware short format (Intl.NumberFormat).
maria: prefer showing full numbers for small values, abbreviated for big ones. so logic: if abs(value) < 1000 => show full, else abbrev. keeps 0.5k from being confusing.
jason: for charts with lots of density i think we should also hide minor tick marks in compact mode. less visual clutter and tick labels can be fewer (every 2nd tick).
eli: on smoothing toggle — should the toggle live inline in the chart header or in the right panel? my vote: inline in header next to chart title so it's discoverable per-chart. default = off for raw telemetry.
taylor: agree about inline. UX nit: label the toggle "Smoothing" + tooltip: "Exponentially smooth short spikes for trend clarity — toggling affects only visualization, not data." 
maria: accessibility: ensure the smoothing toggle is keyboard focusable and has aria-pressed/state. a11y-bot: "reminder: all interactive chart controls must announce state and have visible focus ring"
a11y-bot: please add aria-label="Toggle smoothing for chart" and live region update when toggled: "Smoothing on" / "Smoothing off" for screen readers.
anuj: outlier handling — for top-end spikes i propose a toggled clipping mode: by default show full range, but provide a small "clip" icon in header that opens a menu: Clip to 95th percentile / Show full / Mark outliers. When clipped, show dotted vertical region and a small badge "spikes clipped" with exact max value in tooltip.
jason: visualization rule: don't auto-clip without user action. we can offer a prompt if a new spike exceeds 3x IQR in last 30m: "Spike detected — clip/unclip" CTA.
eli: microcopy proposal for units formatting menu: "Number format: Automatic / Full / Abbreviated (k, M) / SI (K, M) / Custom". keep it as a compact popover.
taylor: small code snippet for consistent number formatting (for frontend):
```
const fmtAuto = v => Math.abs(v) < 1000 ? v.toLocaleString() : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {notation: 'compact', compactDisplay: 'short'}).format(v);
```
maria: +1. Also add tooltip copy for abbreviated values: "0.5k → 500" on hover. helps avoid misinterpretation.
anuj: color/legend note: in compact mode legend markers should be 8px not 12px and label contrast must be AA min. check contrast against dark and light themes. Eli pls add spec.
eli: noted — i'll add legend token sizes and contrast tokens to the PR. proposing 8px marker, 12px hit-target, spacing reduced to 8px.
taylor: one more: mobile/stacked mode — prefer to collapse legend into a single dropdown that shows checkboxes. prevents overflow.
maria: final ask: let's capture decisions: 1) format rule (auto full <1000, abbreviated otherwise), 2) smoothing toggle inline default off + a11y labels, 3) clipping opt-in with explicit UI, 4) compact mode visual tokens (marker size + ticks). i'll file a quick Figma checklist after this thread.
jason: SGTM. can we get a quick mock by EOD? i'll take the task of writing the PR copy for the tooltip strings.
taylor: thanks all — filing a follow-up design task: D-1142 chart-format-and-controls. attaching screenshots in the task. :thumbsup:
